title: MOF modified with a Cu-complex as a novel MOF-based heterogeneous catalyst for the one-pot one-step synthesis of α-aminophosphonates directly from alcohols by a tandem oxidation process
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36823-36836
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06341H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sara Sobhani, Alireza Paseban, Roya Jahanshahi, José Miguel Sansano
Cu-ISA-MIL-Fe successfully catalyzes the direct one-pot synthesis of dialkyl α-aminophosphonates from alcohols via a tandem oxidation process (TOP). The catalyst offers high efficiency and excellent recyclability for sustainable synthesis.
